# Bid the walk, not the bedroom count.

> Price a local moving job from inventory hours plus stairs, long carry, packing, and drive time — then see the walk-away price before you match a cheap bedroom-count quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
